questions.title: Two Integer Sum Drill
questions.description:
Read two integers and print their sum. This drill exercises the addition operator.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print the sum A + B on its own line.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= A, B <= 1000000

questions.title: Modulo Remainder Drill
questions.description:
Read two integers A and B and print the remainder of A divided by B using the modulo operator.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print A % B on its own line.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= A <= 1000000, 1 <= B <= 1000000

questions.title: Post Increment Triple Printer
questions.description:
Read an integer N and print three consecutive integers starting at N, each separated by a space, using the post-increment operator.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print three integers on one line separated by single spaces: N, N+1, N+2.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= N <= 1000000

questions.title: Greater Than Boolean Result
questions.description:
Read two integers and print 1 if the first is strictly greater than the second, otherwise 0. This demonstrates that relational operators in C yield an int value.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print 1 if A > B, else 0.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= A, B <= 1000000

questions.title: Bitwise AND Drill
questions.description:
Read two non-negative integers and print the result of their bitwise AND.

Input Format:
Two space-separated non-negative integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print A & B on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= A, B <= 1000000

questions.title: Bitwise OR Drill
questions.description:
Read two non-negative integers and print the result of their bitwise OR.

Input Format:
Two space-separated non-negative integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print A | B on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= A, B <= 1000000

questions.title: Shopping Cart Total Calculator
questions.description:
A grocery app reads three item prices and prints the cart total to two decimal places.

Input Format:
Three space-separated floating-point prices.

Output Format:
Print the total to two decimal places.

Constraints:
0.0 <= each price <= 10000.0

questions.title: Discounted Price Calculator
questions.description:
A retail checkout reads an original price and a discount percentage, then prints the discounted final price to two decimals.

Input Format:
Two space-separated values: PRICE (double) and DISCOUNT_PERCENT (double).

Output Format:
Print the final price (PRICE - PRICE * DISCOUNT_PERCENT / 100) to two decimals.

Constraints:
0.0 <= PRICE <= 1000000.0, 0.0 <= DISCOUNT_PERCENT <= 100.0

questions.title: Leap Year Ternary Classifier
questions.description:
A calendar tool reads a year and classifies it as a leap year or not using a single conditional (ternary) expression. A year is leap if it is divisible by 4 but not by 100, unless it is also divisible by 400.

Input Format:
A single integer YEAR.

Output Format:
Print "Leap" or "Not Leap" on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= YEAR <= 10000

questions.title: Parking Minutes Round-Up Calculator
questions.description:
A parking garage charges by the hour, rounding any partial hour up. Read the total minutes parked and print the number of billable hours. Use integer arithmetic (no math library).

Input Format:
A single integer MINUTES.

Output Format:
Print the billable hours as an integer (ceiling of MINUTES / 60).

Constraints:
0 <= MINUTES <= 100000

questions.title: Bitwise Permission Flag Packer
questions.description:
A file-system permission tool packs four permission bits (read, write, execute, admin) into a single byte using bit shifts and bitwise OR. Each input is 0 or 1. The packed layout is: read in bit 3, write in bit 2, execute in bit 1, admin in bit 0.

Input Format:
Four space-separated 0/1 values: R W X A.

Output Format:
Print the packed integer value.

Constraints:
Each of R, W, X, A is 0 or 1
questions.inputconstrains: Each of R, W, X, A is 0 or 1

questions.title: Compound Assignment Accumulator
questions.description:
A batch processor reads N integer values, accumulates their sum using the += operator, then multiplies the accumulated sum by a fixed factor using the *= operator. Print the final value.

Input Format:
Line 1: two space-separated integers N and FACTOR.
Next N lines: one integer value each.

Output Format:
Print the final accumulated and scaled value on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000 <= FACTOR <= 1000, -10000 <= each value <= 10000

questions.title: Ternary Tax Bracket Selector
questions.description:
A payroll program classifies an income into tax brackets using a single nested conditional (ternary) expression, without using any if statements.
Brackets:
- income <= 10000: tax = 0
- income <= 50000: tax = (income - 10000) * 0.10
- income <= 100000: tax = 4000 + (income - 50000) * 0.20
- otherwise: tax = 14000 + (income - 100000) * 0.30

Input Format:
A single integer INCOME.

Output Format:
Print the tax amount to two decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= INCOME <= 10000000

questions.title: Bitwise Shift Encoder
questions.description:
A simple obfuscation tool reads a byte value and a non-negative shift amount, then prints the value after a left bitwise shift. Use the shift operator directly.

Input Format:
Two space-separated non-negative integers V and N.

Output Format:
Print V << N on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= V <= 65535, 0 <= N <= 15

questions.title: Precedence-Aware Formula Evaluator
questions.description:
A scientific calculator reads four integers and evaluates the expression a * b + c * d - a using C's default operator precedence (multiplication before addition).

Input Format:
Four space-separated integers A, B, C, D.

Output Format:
Print the integer result of A * B + C * D - A.

Constraints:
-10000 <= A, B, C, D <= 10000

questions.title: Logical Gate Emulator
questions.description:
A digital circuit simulator reads four boolean inputs (each 0 or 1) labeled a, b, c, d and evaluates the boolean expression (a AND b) OR (c AND NOT d) using C's logical operators. Print 1 if the expression is true, 0 otherwise.

Input Format:
Four space-separated 0/1 integers A B C D.

Output Format:
Print 1 or 0.

Constraints:
Each input is 0 or 1

questions.title: Bitwise RGB Color Blender
questions.description:
A graphics utility blends two colors stored as packed 24-bit RGB integers (red in bits 16-23, green in bits 8-15, blue in bits 0-7). For each channel compute the integer average of the two colors, then repack and print the blended color.

Input Format:
Two space-separated non-negative integers C1 and C2 (each in [0, 16777215]).

Output Format:
Print the blended packed RGB value on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= C1, C2 <= 16777215

questions.title: Compound Assignment Currency Exchanger
questions.description:
A currency exchange counter reads N amounts and a single conversion factor. Each amount is converted in place using the *= compound assignment, and the running total is accumulated using the += compound assignment. Print the final total.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer N and floating-point FACTOR, space-separated.
Next N lines: one floating-point amount each.

Output Format:
Print the converted total to two decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 0.0 <= FACTOR <= 1000.0, 0.0 <= amount <= 1000000.0

questions.title: Ternary Grade Classifier
questions.description:
An instructor reads a student's marks (0-100) and classifies the grade using a single nested conditional (ternary) expression without any if or switch statements.

Grading:
- marks >= 90: A
- marks >= 75: B
- marks >= 60: C
- marks >= 40: D
- otherwise: F

Input Format:
A single integer MARKS.

Output Format:
Print the grade letter on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= MARKS <= 100

questions.title: Bitwise Parity Bit Counter
questions.description:
A communications protocol computes the parity of a 32-bit word by counting the number of set bits. Read an unsigned integer and print the count of 1 bits in its binary representation, using a while loop and bitwise operators.

Input Format:
A single unsigned integer N.

Output Format:
Print the count of 1 bits.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 4294967295
